import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'llama-index-core')
from llama_index.core.base.llms.types import ImageBlock
import base64

# Test base64 encoding (default)
data = b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n' + b'fakepngdata'
ib = ImageBlock(image=data)
print('encoding:', ib.encoding)
print('mimetype:', ib.image_mimetype)
print('image is base64:', base64.b64decode(ib.image) == data)

# Test raw encoding
ib2 = ImageBlock(image=data, encoding='raw')
print('raw encoding:', ib2.encoding)
print('raw image unchanged:', ib2.image == data)
print('raw mimetype:', ib2.image_mimetype)

# Test get_image_mimetype lazy
ib3 = ImageBlock(image=data)
print('lazy mimetype:', ib3.get_image_mimetype())
ib4 = ImageBlock(image=None, image_mimetype='image/jpeg')
print('set mimetype:', ib4.get_image_mimetype())

# Test resolve_image with raw
from io import BytesIO
io_raw = ib2.resolve_image()
print('resolve raw:', io_raw.read() == data)
io_b64 = ib2.resolve_image(as_base64=True)
print('resolve raw->b64:', io_b64.read() == base64.b64encode(data))
io_b = ib.resolve_image()
print('resolve b64->raw:', io_b.read() == data)
print('all good')
"
